promotion_note: Algorithmic diagnostic only. Partial-exact sampling, deck schedule, member fitting and primary RNG stream remain unchanged. Damping is state-adaptive and uses only disagreement among the already-fitted regret policies. It is not recovered Deep CFR semantics and requires versioning plus strategic/checkpoint recertification if ever promoted.

uncertainty_damping.intent: Damp only epistemically unstable states instead of globally flattening all behavior.

uncertainty_runtime_statistics_note: Counters cover calls after an Advantage ensemble is fitted; initial zero-regret uniform bootstrap calls are excluded. Instrumentation consumes no RNG and does not alter policy outputs.
